text:
Alex W: Quick UX thought — what if the streaming message showed very subtle chunk-boundary hints (tiny dot + micro-fade) so you can tell when a new partial chunk arrives without it looking noisy? :sparkles:
Maya P: ooh I like that. do you mean a visual marker at token boundaries or at inference chunk flushes?
Alex W: at chunk flushes from the runtime (the points where we append a batch). not every token. think of a 2px dot that appears and fades in ~120ms at the left edge of the message bubble.
Samir: technically feasible. runtime sends chunk metadata already (sequence ids). we can expose a boolean flag `chunk_boundary` in the stream payload. cheap to render.
Irene (prod): +1 but accessibility note — those dots need aria announcements for screen readers. also ensure reduced-motion respects user prefs.
Maya P: agree. copy-wise, avoid calling it a "dot" in UI copy. maybe call it "progress hint" in design docs. for the action button microcopy, can we re-evaluate Stop vs Interrupt vs Cancel? :stop_sign:
Samir: from infra POV, the client sends `stop` which maps to an early termination. We could surface it as "Interrupt" and then show a tooltip "stop generation, keep partial output" for clarity.
Alex W: proposed copy: primary button: "Interrupt" / secondary: "Regenerate". tooltip for Interrupt: "Stop generation and keep current result". tooltip for Regenerate: "Start over with the same prompt". thoughts?
Maya P: short and clear. prefer verb-first labels. we should run these through a quick microcopy test.
Design Bot: microcopy variants recorded: ["Stop"->"Interrupt"], ["Stop"->"Halt"], ["Stop"->"Pause"], results: "Interrupt" had 62% clarity in panel test. attach: /files/microcopy-results-280123.pdf
Irene (prod): Accessibility checklist: 1) aria-live region for partial output (polite), 2) aria-label for Interrupt button, 3) keyboard shortcut `Esc` to interrupt (should be discoverable via tooltip), 4) reduced-motion: disable fades.
Samir: implementing keyboard shortcut as `Esc` collides with some desktop apps, maybe `Ctrl+.` or `Cmd+.`? we can make it configurable under keyboard prefs.
Alex W: let's propose `Esc` as default on the playground only, with an option in Settings to change. include mention in the onboarding tooltip.
Maya P: token counter idea: add a tiny sparkline next to the token count showing token arrival rate (tokens/sec) during the current stream. helps users see burstiness.
Samir: we can compute tokens/sec client-side from chunk timing. low perf cost.
Irene (prod): ensure the sparkline has high-contrast mode and alt text: "Token rate: X tokens per second" for screen readers.
Alex W: prompt library UX: add a collapsible "Prompt Dock" below composer that keeps 3 pinned prompts and quick-insert icons. when streaming, dock should auto-collapse unless user pins it.
Maya P: animate collapse gently (unless reduced-motion). the pinned state should be clearly labelled and keyboard-focusable.
Design Bot: notes added to Figma: https://redwood.design/figma/proj/playground/stream-boundary-hint (see frames 12-15).
Samir: small dev note — new stream flag name `chunk_boundary_hint: true|false` and `chunk_sequence` int. frontend will render boundary markers only if hint flag present.
Irene (prod): before we ship, run an a11y pass and a small user study with 6 devs to validate the Interrupt/regenerate language and the sparkline comprehension.
Alex W: thanks all — I'll sketch annotated frames and push a short PR to the design repo. pinging @Maya P for microcopy sign-off.
Maya P: will review by EOD.
